subject: Proposal: feature-credit pool for reduced seats and SLA clarification
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@horizonhealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:12:00Z
Subject: Adjusting our plan — reduce seats, keep advanced features?

Hi Karthik,

We're reviewing our contract ahead of the July renewal and are exploring whether we can reduce the number of developer seats while keeping the advanced features we rely on (private VPC, dedicated inference endpoint, and the model audit logs). A couple of constraints from our side:

- We expect a steady 35% drop in active seats for the next 6 months but occasional spikes for quarterly batch runs.
- We need to keep the dedicated endpoint (latency SLO matters) and the VPC setup for compliance.
- Procurement will want clear pricing delta and any one-time fees; legal will want SLA language for the dedicated endpoint.

Questions:
1) Can Redwood re-bundle features so we pay for fewer seats but retain the add-ons we need?
2) Do you offer any mechanism to convert unused seat capacity to credits so we don't lose paid value when we downsize?
3) If we accept a re-bundled package, what concessions on price or SLA credits can you provide if latency targets slip?

Can you send a concrete delta and a simple one-page proposal we can run up the chain? Procurement (procurement@horizonhealth.ai) is copied on next replies.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Director of AI
Horizon Health

---
Note: attaching our internal May usage export for context (will send if useful).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@horizonhealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Adjusting our plan — Proposal: tradeable feature credits (D-2026-487)

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear note and the usage signal.

Short answer: yes, we can support a seat-down/re-bundle with options that preserve your critical add-ons. I sketched a pragmatic construct below and attached a one-page proposal PDF for procurement. (attachment: horizon_feature_pool_proposal.pdf)

Proposal (high level):
- Convert up to 40% of active seats to a 12-month "feature credit pool" redeemable against advanced add-ons (dedicated endpoint, VPC management, model audit logs).
- Credits are consumed monthly based on active usage of each add-on; unused credits roll for 12 months.
- Price: 15% list discount applied to credits up to the first 6 months; additional volume discounts to be tiered if you commit to a 9–12 month runway.
- SLA concession: offer one-time service credit equal to up to 30 days of fees for the affected add-on if the dedicated endpoint misses the committed p50/p95 latency targets in any given month (detailed SLA language to be added to the SOW).

Benefits for Horizon Health: preserves compliance posture and dedicated performance while reducing seat cost and protecting value during your temporary headcount change.

Internal ask: Ben / Lauren — can you review the attached PDF and confirm we can approve the 15% credit discount + SLA credit structure for D-2026-487? If legal needs specific SLA wording in the SOW we should flag it now.

Emma / Procurement — if this looks directionally right I'll produce a short SOW draft and a final price delta table (monthly run rates) to circulate.

Next step: I'll follow up with a short SOW and numbers if you confirm interest.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: horizon_feature_pool_proposal.pdf

From: Emma Li <emma.li@horizonhealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-05-15T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: tradeable feature credits for reduced seats and SLA clarification

Thanks Karthik — the proposal looks promising. A few clarifying points before we proceed:

- Consumption model: how are credits consumed when we have a short spike (e.g., one week at +200% inference volume)? Do credits apply to peak months or are we billed overage?
- Can we cap monthly spend so procurement can include a hard ceiling in the PO?
- For the dedicated endpoint SLA, can you confirm p50/p95 targets for the model family we're using and whether the credit calculation is pro-rated by impacted tokens/requests?

I'll attach our May usage export for reference (usage_report_May.csv). Procurement wants the delta table (current vs proposed monthly run-rate) and the SOW language for SLA credits to review in their next meeting.

-Emma

Emma Li
Director of AI, Horizon Health
procurement@horizonhealth.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T12:40:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: tradeable feature credits for reduced seats and SLA clarification — approval needed

Forwarding Emma's clarifying questions (below). Need quick sign-off so I can send a consolidated price/SOW to procurement.

TL;DR ask: approve up to 18% on-credit discount for the feature-pool for the first 6 months and allow the one-time SLA credit (up to 30 days) in the SOW as drafted. Also confirm we can offer a hard monthly cap as a procurement-friendly option (will be a committed overage cap).

Background (copied):
> From: Emma Li <emma.li@horizonhealth.ai>
> Date: 2026-05-15T09:20:00Z
> Subject: Re: Proposal: tradeable feature credits for reduced seats and SLA clarification
> 
> Thanks Karthik — the proposal looks promising. A few clarifying points before we proceed: ...

Notes/asks for legal/finance:
- If we allow an 18% discount (vs. my original 15%), finance will need to register the concession and track renewal behavior.
- SLA credit language: can Legal draft a short clause that ties the credit to monthly service fee for the affected add-on and specifies measurement windows (p50/p95 for 1-minute aggregation)?

Attachments to send to customer after sign-off: SOW-draft.docx (short).

Thanks — Karthik

Attachment: SOW-draft.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: tradeable feature credits — approval needed

Karthik / Lauren —

I can approve this with two constraints:
1) Cap the on-credit discount at 15% for the first six months; we can tier to 18% only if they commit to a 12-month runway (renewal or prepaid credits).
2) SLA credit: we can offer up to 30 days of service credit (monetary cap $12,000) for missed p95 targets, but legal must add explicit measurement windows and an exclusion for bursts caused by misconfiguration on their side.

Also require that procurement accepts the hard monthly cap as an optional add-on (if they want it, we include it as a committed overage cap with a one-time set-up fee).

Ben
VP, Sales Operations

P.S. route final SOW through legal and mark the HubSpot deal D-2026-487 before sending to customer.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@horizonhealth.ai>, Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T17:00:00Z
Subject: Final: Horizon Health — feature-credit pool proposal and next steps (D-2026-487)

Hi Emma / Procurement team — thanks for the patience. Per internal review we've refined the proposal and attached a short SOW and the delta table of run-rates. Key points:

- Feature-credit pool: convert up to 40% of current seats into a 12-month pool redeemable for advanced add-ons. Unused credits rollover for up to 12 months.
- Pricing: 15% discount on credits for the first 6 months (we can expand to 18% if Horizon commits to a 12-month credit purchase).
- SLA credit: up to 30 days service credit capped at $12,000 for missed p95 targets (exclusions for customer-caused misconfiguration). Detailed measurement windows in SOW.
- Hard monthly spend cap: available as an optional committed cap (one-time set-up fee applies).

Attachments: SOW-draft.docx, horizon_feature_pool_proposal.pdf, usage_report_May.csv

Next steps:
1) Please confirm (by reply) if Horizon wants the optional monthly cap and if you prefer the 6-month 15% discount or the 12-month 18% commitment.
2) If confirmed, I'll route the SOW to Legal and send a DocuSign link for signature. HubSpot: D-2026-487.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/D-2026-487
